summary: The StudentPrerequisites file contains the complete data structure, business logic, data formatting methods, workflow processes, validations, dependencies, and exception handling for recording, updating, and validating student immunization and safety prerequisites within HSPnet. It covers all key immunization and health requirement fields for students, including workflow methods for CRUD operations and detailed per-field validation logic.
purpose: To manage and validate the immunization, health, safety, confidentiality, and infection control prerequisites for students, including required dates, status codes, supporting notes, and evidence, for compliance with institutional and regulatory requirements.

workflows.name: StudentDetailsPrerequisitesSearch
steps: Execute query, map data to StudentPrerequisite

workflows.name: StudentDetailsImmunizationUpdate
steps: Add parameters for all immunization, health, and status fields

workflows.name: StudentDetailsInfectionUpdate
steps: Add mask, expiry, notes, infection control parameters

workflows.name: StudentDetailsSafetyUpdate
steps: Add safety-related parameters (CRC, IDCard, WCB, etc.)

business_rules: Mandatory year and date ranges for immunization records (MIN_YEAR to MaxYear)
Expiry dates and test dates cannot be more than 5 years in the future
Certain dates must be valid if specific codes are given (e.g., Fit test date required if mask size specified)
Status codes and supporting notes must align with regulatory requirements
Consent program and form received dates are mandatory for confidential records
validations: IsValid method on StudentPrerequisite ensures all business rules are enforced
Checks for non-null, valid dates on all date fields
Field-specific validation for mask size, expiry, immunizations, confidentiality, and consent
Error messages and workflow halt if validations are not met
calculations: TetanusExpiryDate calculation: If not manually set, defaults to 10 years after TetanusAdminDate
N95MaskFitTestExpiryCheck returns '1' for 1-year, '2' for 2-year intervals, '0' otherwise
Formatted fields for display purposes (e.g., date formatting, conditional red text for negative titres)
Expiry warning formatting if expiry is soon or has passed
conditions: If OccHealthReqMetStatusCodeID == 0, ImmunReqMetDate is set to NullDate
If mask size is set but not known, N95MaskSizeUnknownCodeID set by code search
system_behavior: Descriptive fields are loaded for both English and French, depending on user/session language
All updates are routed through database stored procedures with field-level parameters
Error handling is consistent, returning error messages to the session for UI consumption
exceptions: AddError returns for invalid date ranges, invalid/missing fields
Exceptions for database errors are handled by the underlying DB layer
